title: Closed-component retraction for an algebra map identifying stalks
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with R and S w-local [def-weil-pbc-w-local], equipped with an R-algebra structure on S. Assume the algebra map R \to S induces bijections on all prime stalks [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and every closed point of Spec S contracts to a closed point of Spec R. Let T be a closed subset of the connected-component space π₀(Spec S). If the restriction to T of the map π₀(Spec S) \to π₀(Spec R) induced by contraction is bijective, then there exists a ring map f:S\to R with f\circ(R\to S)=\mathrm{id}_R.

statement_change.old_statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with R and S w-local [def-weil-pbc-w-local], equipped with an R-algebra structure on S. Assume the algebra map R \to S induces bijections on all prime stalks [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and every closed point of Spec S contracts to a closed point of Spec R. Let T be a closed subset of the connected-component space π₀(Spec S). If the map π₀(Spec S) \to π₀(Spec R) induced by contraction is surjective and injective on T (equivalently, its restriction to T is bijective), then there exists a ring map f:S\to R with f\circ(R\to S)=\mathrm{id}_R.
statement_change.what: The phrase "is surjective and injective on T" admits global surjectivity plus injectivity on T, which is not equivalent to bijectivity of the restriction to T. For R=S=F_2 and T empty, the global map is surjective and injective on T but the restriction is not surjective. Require surjectivity from T, as the source and the parent node do. This resolves the false parenthetical equivalence without changing the source-intended statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_retraction_of_isClosed_of_bijOn [IsWLocalRing R]
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsWLocalRing S]
    (hbos : (algebraMap R S).BijectiveOnStalks)
    (hcl : ∀ y ∈ closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum S),
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) y ∈ closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum R))
    (T : Set (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum S))) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (hsurjT : ∀ c : ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum R), ∃ t ∈ T,
      (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap R S)).connectedComponentsMap t = c)
    (hinjT : ∀ t₁ ∈ T, ∀ t₂ ∈ T,
      (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap R S)).connectedComponentsMap t₁ =
        (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap R S)).connectedComponentsMap t₂ →
      t₁ = t₂) :
    ∃ f : S →+* R, f.comp (algebraMap R S) = RingHom.id R
lean.note: Exact existing theorem after correcting the ambiguous component-surjectivity clause to surjectivity from T, as in Tag 09AZ and the upstream theorem. Section parameters are {R : Type u} [CommRing R]; S : Type u. The single universe is arbitrary and covers any pair of ring sizes by taking their maximum.
